title: 第6章 故地重游
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

十几天的时间一晃而过，江蓠透过车窗，扫了一眼远处那巨大的金属建筑。

庚辛城不愧是金属之都，城墙都泛着金属光泽，即便相隔甚远，空气里依稀能嗅到一股铁锈和焦炭混合的味道。

这熟悉的场景，这熟悉的味道，还是和十几年前一样，仿佛时间从未在这座钢铁铸成的城市中留下痕迹。

刚入城门，马车便被两把长枪拦了下来。

“站住，入城费一个银魂币。”

“什么时候庚辛城还需要入城费了？”

守卫冷哼一声。

“交不交？不交就别进来。”

看着守卫那猖狂的眼神，江蓠强忍住动手的欲望，为了一个小人物而引起大动静，不值得！

深吸了口气，默默的从魂导器取出一枚金魂币递了过去。

守卫见到金魂币，眼睛瞬间亮了起来，轻轻弹了一下，耳边传来清脆悠扬的声音。

“找钱！”

守卫随手将金魂币收好，一脸的淡然。

“找什么钱？”

此言一出，马车里的气氛瞬间冷了下来。

区区一个站岗的普通守卫，修为不过大魂师级别，竟然敢公然敲诈，嚣张得毫无底线。

要知道，十二年前可没人敢这样，可想而知，这些年的变化究竟有多大！

江蓠的指尖也悄然攥紧，袖中五指泛白。

古榕只是饶有兴趣的看着这一幕，他也很想知道遇到这种事，江蓠会怎么处理。

“看你们面生，是外地来的吧？”另一名守卫嗤笑一声，吊儿郎当地扛着长枪，语气极尽嘲讽，“新来的不懂规矩？”

两人态度傲慢跋扈，显然没少做这种仗势欺人的勾当。

蛛儿趴在江蓠肩头，八条细腿骤然绷紧，小小的身躯透着凶狠的戾气，复眼死死盯着门外两名守卫，仿佛下一秒就要窜出去发动攻击。

江蓠抬手轻轻按住蛛儿，将她躁动的情绪安抚下来，垂眸掩去眼底翻涌的凛冽杀意。

她清楚，现在不能冲动。

若是此刻动手，打草惊蛇，惊动了城内的迈尔斯，万一被当场认出，到时候，她就麻烦了。

“让路。”

江蓠淡淡开口，声音听不出喜怒，平静得可怕。

两名守卫见她服软，愈发得意，挥手不耐烦地驱赶。

“哼，算你小子识相！不过嘛，这是之前的价格，现在，我要十个金魂币。”

此话一出，江蓠指尖不受控制的微微颤抖，那眼中不知何时多了一抹淡淡的血色。

十几年积攒的杀气，在这一刻，她甚至都已经压制不住了。

“咳咳。”

一声咳嗽带着一股精神力传来，江蓠整个人为之一振，眼中也是浮现一抹清明，这才反应了过来，杀气，差一点就失控了。

深吸了口气这才看向了对面坐着的古榕。

“多谢。”

“无妨。”古榕摆了摆手，便是再度闭上了眼睛。

“快点，别磨蹭，不然就不是这个价了。”

想要钱？

很好，那就别怪我了。

江蓠的手指微微动了动，指尖悄无声息地划过魂导器中取出的金魂币。

只是一瞬，金色的币面上多了一抹暗紫色的光芒，转瞬即逝。

Page (1/3)

More than ten days passed by in a flash. Jiang Li glanced at the huge metal building in the distance through the car window.

Gengxin City is worthy of being the capital of metals. The city walls are all glowing with metallic luster. Even though they are far apart, you can vaguely smell a smell of rust and coke in the air.

This familiar scene and this familiar smell are still the same as they were more than ten years ago, as if time has never left any trace in this city made of steel.

As soon as they entered the city gate, the carriage was stopped by two spears.

"Stop, it costs one Gintama coin to enter the city."

"When will Gengxin City need to pay entry fees?"

The guard snorted coldly.

"Do you want to hand it over? If you don't hand it over, don't come in."

Looking at the guard's wild eyes, Jiang Li resisted the desire to take action. It was not worth it to cause a big fuss for a small person!

Taking a deep breath, he silently took out a golden soul coin from the soul guide and handed it over.

When the guard saw the golden soul coin, his eyes lit up instantly. He flicked it lightly and heard a clear and melodious sound in his ears.

"Change!"

The guard casually put the gold soul coin away with a nonchalant look on his face.

"What money do you want?"

As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere in the carriage instantly became cold.

A mere ordinary guard standing guard, whose cultivation level was no higher than that of a great soul master, dared to openly blackmail him, and was so arrogant that he had no bottom line.

You know, no one would have dared to do this twelve years ago. You can imagine how much has changed in these years!

Jiang Li's fingertips were quietly clenched, and the fingers in her sleeves turned white.

Gu Rong just watched this scene with interest. He also wanted to know how Jiang Li would handle such a thing.

"Looking at your appearance, you are from out of town, right?" Another guard sneered, holding his spear carelessly, his tone was extremely mocking, "The new guy doesn't understand the rules?"

The two of them were arrogant and domineering, and they obviously did this kind of bullying.

Zhu'er lay on Jiang Li's shoulder, her eight thin legs suddenly tightened, her small body exuding a ferocious aura, and her compound eyes stared at the two guards outside the door, as if she was about to rush out and attack in the next second.

Jiang Li raised her hand and gently pressed Zhu'er down to calm her restless emotions. She lowered her eyes to hide the murderous intent surging in her eyes.

She knew better than to be impulsive now.

If she took action now, alerted Miles in the city, and if she was recognized on the spot, she would be in trouble.

"Make way."

Jiang Li spoke calmly, with no hint of emotion or anger in her voice, which was terrifyingly calm.

Seeing her surrender, the two guards became more and more proud and waved their hands to drive her away impatiently.

"Hmph, you're a smart kid! But, this was the price before. Now, I want ten gold soul coins."

As soon as these words came out, Jiang Li's fingertips trembled uncontrollably, and a touch of blood appeared in her eyes.

At this moment, she couldn't even suppress the murderous aura she had accumulated for more than ten years.

"Ahem."

A cough came with a burst of spiritual power, Jiang Li's whole body was shaken up, and a touch of clarity appeared in his eyes. Only then did he react, and his murderous aura almost got out of control.

He took a deep breath and then looked at Gu Rong sitting opposite.

"Thank you."

"It doesn't matter." Gu Rong waved his hand and closed his eyes again.

"Hurry up, don't delay, otherwise it won't be the price."

Want money?

Great, then don't blame me.

Jiang Li's fingers moved slightly, and her fingertips silently passed over the golden soul coin taken out of the soul guide.

Just for a moment, a dark purple light appeared on the golden coin surface, and it disappeared in an instant.
